afterImage.subsector: Energy solutions and building infrastructure services
afterImage.description: ENFRA, LLC designs, builds, finances and operates energy, engineering and building-infrastructure solutions for healthcare, higher-education, government, commercial and industrial customers. The company provides engineering, construction, commissioning, maintenance, asset management, optimization, resilience and energy-as-a-service solutions. ENFRA is the same continuing legal entity formerly named Bernhard, LLC; the legal name changed effective May 1, 2025 without changing the entity, EIN, ownership, legal structure or contracts. DIF Infrastructure VI agreed to acquire Bernhard in October 2021 and the sale closed on December 2, 2021. ENFRA continues to identify CVC DIF as its majority owner; the exact fund stake, management rollover percentage and acquisition SPV are not publicly disclosed. The company traces its predecessor heritage to 1919, is headquartered in Metairie, Louisiana and reports operations across 18 states. Subsidiaries, tuck-ins and customer energy-as-a-service projects remain beneath ENFRA unless separate manager ownership is proven. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
